metadata.description: Multi-agent framework for modernizing software systems from code, documents or both.

plugins.name: modernia
plugins.description: A team of 13 AI agents that modernizes a legacy system in any technology, from code, documents or both: diagnosis, estimation (time, team and cost), architecture options, backlog, build by sprints (tests first, independent review, security) and release by waves, with human approval gates, a live dashboard, and the right Claude model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable) chosen for each task.
